recommendations.name: pr-risk-scorer
recommendations.description: A free GitHub Action that rates each pull request across five structural dimensions and posts the weighted score as a PR comment, though I couldn't load its page to confirm license or maintenance.

recommendations.name: CodeRabbit Merge Risk
recommendations.description: A paid review tool that gives every pull request a Minimal to Critical merge-risk rating in its summary comment, can cap auto-approval by risk level, and works on GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps and Bitbucket.

recommendations.name: Qodo Merge Risk
recommendations.description: Rates each pull request Low, Medium or High from blast radius, behavioral complexity and potential damage, and can add the rating as a label on GitHub, GitLab and Azure DevOps (off by default, enabled in the Qodo portal).
